26 Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 (c. 38)
Document Generated: 2025-03-21
Changes to legislation: There are currently no known outstanding effects
for the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971. (See end of Document for details)
Marginal Citations
M6 1968 c. 59.
[F5023A Temporary class drugs: further power to search, seize and detain

(1) Subsection (3) applies in any case where—
(a) a constable has reasonable grounds to suspect that a person (“P”) is in
possession of a temporary class drug, and
(b) it does not appear to the constable that a power under section 23(2) applies
to the case.

(2) But if any provision has been made by virtue of section 7A(2)(c) (excepted possession)
that applies to the temporary class drug in question, subsection (3) applies only if the
constable has no reason to believe that P's possession of the drug is to be treated as
excepted possession for the purposes of this Act.
